author: Joeyceo
quote:
I gave GTA 6 five hours. I went in excited, and that smile faded as soon as the characters started talking. The dialogue was so cringy and uninspired that I didn’t laugh once. 

After five hours with these characters, I should’ve cared what happened to at least one of them. Instead, I just wanted them to finish talking.I’ve played GTA for over 20 years. Why does it suddenly feel like I’m being punished for playing the way I always have? And when the story finally gives my character a reason to step up and take the lead, why does somebody else get that moment? I’m the one holding the controller, and somehow I feel like a bystander in my own story.

At one point I literally sat there for about 15 minutes with my hands on my head, staring at the pause menu, thinking, “What the fxck am I playing?” I turned it off after five hours and haven’t touched it since. I honestly don’t know who this game was made for. It wasn't for me.
